stories.title: Exclusive: Body camera video shows Spokane County deputies detaining Aaron Farinacci after Old Trails Fire starts
stories.summary: While making a phone call shortly before being handcuffed, Farinacci could be heard saying, “If it’s all square, I’ll be let go. If it’s not, I’ll be arrested.”

stories.title: Rolling slowdowns planned on I-90 Wednesday for procession honoring Spokane County deputies
stories.summary: The first rolling slowdown is scheduled for 9:22 a.m. along eastbound I-90, while the second is set for 11:22 a.m. westbound.

stories.title: Fall City teen accused of killing 5 family members appears in court, pleads not guilty
stories.summary: King County Judge Veronica Galván previously ruled the teen will be tried as an adult.

stories.title: Washington medical organizations 'deeply troubled' by trans girls sports ban, support pausing new law
stories.summary: The state's medical association and other healthcare organizations voiced support for a lawsuit seeking to pause implementation of I-638.

stories.title: Candlelight vigil for fallen Spokane County Deputies happening Tuesday night
stories.summary: The vigil honoring Deputies Parker Perry and Mason Acheson will be held at the Law Enforcement Memorial Monument (1100 West Mallon Avenue) and will start at 7 p.m.

stories.title: Experts expect busy roads and crowded flights for holidays
stories.summary: Experts forecast busy roads and packed planes in the coming months.

stories.title: Coeur d’Alene Rec Department buckets revenue increases
stories.summary: Like a fast-break layup, yields are rising for Coeur d’Alene’s recreation department.

stories.title: West Coast Health Alliance urges vaccination after loss of measles elimination status, deadly U.S. outbreaks
stories.summary: This year, Washington has seen nearly five times as many cases as were reported in all of 2025.

stories.title: Four Timberline football players sue over discipline tied to alleged threats of sexual violence
stories.summary: The students allege school leaders violated their rights when disciplining them over allegedly sending violent and sexual messages directed at a female student.

stories.title: Coeur d'Alene Police determined "unexploded device" that prompted evacuations is a commercial firework
stories.summary: A report of a possible explosive device caused evacuations in Belmont and Appaloosa around 5 p.m. Monday.

stories.title: Idaho family drops healthcare insurance amid rising premiums, faces financial risk for medical care
stories.summary: Joshua and Ashley Durham, who run a family medical practice, face difficult choices with rising health insurance costs, now opting to pay out of pocket.

stories.title: Inland Power, Avista restore outages that affected thousands Monday evening
stories.summary: A car crash caused power outages across Cheney, Four Lakes, and the Spokane Airport area Monday evening, according to Inland Power and Avista.
